limitations: Observed moments are used when retained; record append time is separately retained.
Per-stage medians and overlapping spans must not be added as one execution timeline.
ready-to-SEND is summarized from each case's own difference, not a difference of endpoint medians.
RGB fingerprinting is enabled only for this opt-in synthetic evidence and adds real diagnostic CPU cost.
Dictionary worker start/end or CPU timing is not recorded; overlap is a hypothesis, not a causal isolation.
Equal intermediate FNV64 fingerprints are recorded fingerprints, not an independent full-pixel comparison.
Driver completion waits do not observe optical panel completion.
No continuous memory profile or peak RSS attribution is made.
scope: Read-only projection from already collected physical evidence; no device access, lease, new app run or overwritten analysis.
